About Me

The Rider Behind the Handlebars

Based in Dhaka, I am an adventure enthusiast and avid traveler. Beside my professional role as Manager at M Faruk Motors, my true passion lies in exploring new destinations, motorbike expeditions, and collecting unique experiences.

My journeys are driven by one core philosophy: Adventure, Creativity, and Continuous Learning.
